info.title: Pluck Studio — /v1/runs + /v1/watches API
info.summary: Unified pipeline activation (Bureau /v1/runs) + periodic semantic monitoring (/v1/watches).
info.description: Auto-generated from `src/lib/v1/run-spec.ts` and `src/lib/v1/watch-spec.ts`. Pipeline + status enums are derived from the TypeScript taxonomy (`BUREAU_PIPELINES` / `FUTURE_PIPELINES` / `RUN_STATUSES`, `AUTONOMY_MODES` / `FETCHER_KINDS` / `WATCH_STATUSES` / `OBSERVATION_KINDS` / `OBSERVATION_CLASSIFICATIONS`). Per-pipeline run payload schemas live in `docs/V1_API.md`. Re-run `pnpm openapi:build` after any spec / validator / redactor change.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Unified pipeline activation surface. POST creates, GET-list and GET-by-id are public-read, DELETE cancels.

tags.name: Watches
tags.description: Periodic semantic monitoring. POST creates, GET (list + single) are public-read, PATCH updates a subset, DELETE archives (soft delete), POST /trigger fires manually, GET /events streams SSE.

post.description: Activate any pipeline. Same-site enforced via Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin / Referer. Auth required — Supabase session cookie in production, dev-mode `Authorization: Bearer <token>` outside production. Idempotent: same `idempotencyKey` + canonicalised (pipeline, payload) returns the same `runId` with `reused=true`.

get.description: Public-read by phraseId model. Same-site (CSRF) and rate-limit gates apply. Per-pipeline GET-side redaction applied to each item's `payload`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Runs created strictly after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: RunStatus filter. Single value (`?status=cancelled`) or comma-separated (`?status=pending,running`). Whitespace tolerated.

200.description: Paginated list of redacted run records.

get.summary: Get a single run (public read, redacted)
get.description: Public read — the phraseId in the URL is the share credential. Same-site (CSRF) and rate-limit gates apply. Per-pipeline GET-side redaction applied to `payload`.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending or running run
delete.description: Cancel verb — does NOT erase the record. A cancelled run still resolves through GET so its receipt URL stays valid for audit + share. Auth required (same gate as POST). Final states (`anchored` | `failed`) return 409. Already-cancelled returns 200 with `alreadyCancelled=true`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: phraseId of the run to cancel.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of run progress (public, redacted)
get.description: Long-lived `text/event-stream` connection. Emits an initial `state` event with the current redacted RunRecord on connect, a fresh `state` event on every status transition, and a `heartbeat` event every 30 seconds. Auto-closes after a 2s grace window when the run reaches a terminal status (`anchored` | `failed` | `cancelled`) and after a hard 5-minute lifetime cap. Honors the standard `Last-Event-ID` request header on reconnect — the server resumes its id counter from `Last-Event-ID + 1`. Same security posture as `GET /api/v1/runs/{id}`: same-site (CSRF) + rate-limit gates, NO auth gate (the phraseId in the URL is the share credential). Per-pipeline GET-side redaction applies to EVERY emitted state event — defense-in-depth at the SSE boundary. NOTE: OpenAPI has no first-class SSE schema; consumers should use the platform `EventSource` API (or equivalent).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: phraseId of the run to stream.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Standard SSE reconnect header. Server resumes its event-id counter from `Last-Event-ID + 1`. Non-numeric values fall back to `1`.

200.description:
SSE stream. Each message is `id: <n>
event: <state|heartbeat|error>
data: <json>

`. The `state` event's `data` is a redacted RunRecord; the `heartbeat` event's `data` is `{ ts: <unix-ms> }`.

post.description: Create a periodic semantic monitor. Idempotent on `(ownerId, name, url, intent, fetcherKind, idempotencyKey)`. Returns the envelope on success — clients that need the full record after create should GET `/v1/watches/{watchId}`.

value.name: OpenAI pricing watch
value.intent: Alert when GPT-4 input token price changes from its current value, especially on the API pricing table.

get.description: Public read by phraseId model — same posture as `/v1/runs`. Operator address lists in `alertChannels` are stripped (replaced with counts). Archived watches are hidden by default; pass `?status=archived` to surface them.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: WatchStatus filter. Single value or comma-separated (≤10 values). Unknown values return 400.

200.description: Paginated list of redacted watch records.

get.description: Public read by phraseId. Response inlines the most recent observation history (cap 20) so the receipt page renders without a second round trip.

example.name: OpenAI pricing watch
example.intent: Alert when GPT-4 input token price changes from its current value.

patch.description: Partial update. Operator-mutable fields only — `url`, `intent`, `fetcherKind` are immutable post-create (change those by archiving + recreating). Returns the full PublicWatchRecord.

delete.description: Archive verb — record stays for audit; observation history is preserved. `DELETE /v1/runs/:id` cancels because runs cannot be paused; `DELETE /v1/watches/:id` archives because watches CAN be paused via `PATCH status=paused`. Idempotent: already-archived returns 200 with `alreadyArchived: true`.

post.description: Manual fire-now. Per-watch cooldown applies (15 s) to defeat trigger amplification — exceeded returns 429 with `Retry-After` + `retryAfterMs` payload. Week-1 stub runs a server-side fetch with manual redirect-walking + DNS-rebinding guard + HTTPS-downgrade rejection; Week-2 proxies to the Worker (Playwright + agent).

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream of watch progress (public, redacted)
get.description: Long-lived `text/event-stream` connection. Emits an initial redacted PublicWatchRecord as a `state` event on connect; fresh `state` events on every transition; `observation` events when observations are recorded; `alert` events on per-channel dispatch (Week-2+); `heartbeat` every 30 s. Hard 5-minute connection cap. Honors `Last-Event-ID` (strict `^\d{1,8}$`, clamped to `[0, 1_000_000]`). Per-watch subscriber cap 100 / global 5000 → `error` event + close.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Standard SSE reconnect header. Server resumes its event-id counter from `Last-Event-ID + 1`.

200.description:
SSE stream. Each message is `id: <n>
event: <state|observation|alert|heartbeat|error>
data: <json>

`. The `state` event's data is a `PublicWatchRecord`; `observation` data is an `ObservationRecord`; `heartbeat` data is `{ ts: <unix-ms> }`.

BureauPipeline.description: One of the 11 Bureau program slugs. Each maps 1:1 to the legacy `/api/bureau/<slug>/run` route.

RunSpecPipeline.description: All known pipelines — 11 Bureau slugs (shipped) + 4 future surface slugs (extract/sense/act/fleet, return 400 today).

VerdictColor.description: Traffic-light tag used by receipt UIs. `gray` = no verdict yet.

payload.description: Per-pipeline payload — see docs/V1_API.md `Per-pipeline payload reference` for the 11 shapes.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-supplied. Same key + same canonicalised (pipeline, payload) returns the same runId (with `reused=true`).

runId.description: phraseId — receipt URL primitive + share credential.

payload.description: Echoed payload (audit). Privacy redaction applies on GET — fields like WHISTLE.bundleUrl and ROTATE.operatorNote are stripped.

response.description: Pipeline-specific response — null until data exists.

reused.description: True when an idempotency replay returned the existing record.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor; null when no more pages.

totalCount.description: Total matching the filter across all pages.

alreadyCancelled.description: True when the run was already cancelled (idempotent).

signInUrl.description: Present on 401 from POST. Pipeline-aware redirect.

status.description: Present on 409 from DELETE — the final-state status.

retryAfterMs.description: Present on 429 from POST /v1/watches/{id}/trigger — wait this many ms before retrying.

AutonomyMode.description: Watch-level autonomy. `diff-gated` runs a cheap text diff before the agent; `full-auto` always runs the agent + alerts when confidence > threshold; `always-agent` routes every observation to a human-confirm queue.

FetcherKind.description: How the worker fetches the watched URL. `browserbase` is a v2 stub.

WatchStatus.description: Watch lifecycle. `running` is transient; `failed` flips on consecutive errors; `archived` is soft-delete.

ObservationKind.description: What the runtime recorded. `baseline` is the first observation; `no-change` is the diff-gated short-circuit; `error` carries failure-as-data.

ObservationClassification.description: Agent's semantic verdict over the snapshot.

AlertChannels.description: Inbound channel selection. All operator-supplied URLs (webhook, slack) pass the same public-host SSRF guard as the watch URL. At least one channel MUST be enabled.

PublicAlertChannelSummary.description: Redacted channel summary on public reads — address arrays are replaced with counts.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Localhost / RFC1918 / link-local / reserved-TLD rejected.

intent.description: Natural-language directive — what the agent should watch for.

status.description: Operator-mutable subset of WatchStatus. `running` and `failed` are runtime-internal.

watchId.description: Pluck phrase-id; share credential for the receipt URL.

lastFiredAt.description: ISO timestamp; null until first fire.

receiptUrl.description: Path to the receipt page, e.g. `/watch/<watchId>`.

PublicWatchRecord.description: GET-side view of a watch — operator address lists in alertChannels (email/webhook/slack) are redacted to counts. The stored record retains the addresses.

prevObservationId.description: Null on first run and on `error` kind (don't chain errors to baselines).

modelUsed.description: Provider/model that produced the observation. Null for `no-change` and Week-1 mock observations.

reused.description: True when an idempotency replay returned the existing record.

CreateWatchResponse.description: Envelope-on-create. GET / PATCH / DELETE return the full PublicWatchRecord.

BadRequest.description: Invalid body, query, or path parameter.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token / session cookie.

Forbidden.description: Cross-site request rejected. Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin / Referer enforcement.

Conflict.description: Run is in a final state (`anchored` | `failed`) and cannot be cancelled.

example.error: run is in final state 'anchored' and cannot be cancelled
too many requests — slow down and try again in a minute

bearerAuth.description: Dev-mode affordance — accepted only outside production. Production honours `sessionCookie` only.
